<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- cell wall -->
    <rect x="60" y="40" width="260" height="190" rx="10" ry="10" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- cell membrane -->
    <rect x="68" y="48" width="244" height="174" rx="8" ry="8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- permanent vacuole -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="140" rx="60" ry="40" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- nucleus -->
    <circle cx="120" cy="140" r="28" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- chloroplasts -->
    <ellipse cx="100" cy="200" rx="18" ry="11" stroke-width="1" fill="#eeeeee"/>
    <ellipse cx="250" cy="75" rx="18" ry="11" stroke-width="1" fill="#eeeeee"/>
    <!-- leader lines -->
    <line x1="60" y1="60" x2="38" y2="38" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="68" y1="150" x2="35" y2="150" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="190" y1="135" x2="225" y2="122" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="140" x2="100" y2="100" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="200" x2="150" y2="215" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <text x="26" y="34">A</text>
    <text x="10" y="155">B</text>
    <text x="228" y="126">C</text>
    <text x="84" y="104" text-anchor="end">D</text>
    <text x="155" y="220">E</text>
    <text x="200" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 1.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
